description: The Kakhovka Dam was a dam on the Dnieper River (also known as the Dnipro), in the Kherson region of Ukraine. Completed in 1956 and demolished in 2023, it supplied water to the 351 MW Kakhovka Hydroelectric Power Plant (Ukrainian: Кахо́вська ГЕС імені П. С. Непорожнього, romanized: Kakhovs'ka HES imeni P. S. Neporozhn'oho). The dam's main purposes were hydroelectric power generation, irrigation, and navigation. It was the sixth and final dam in the Dnieper reservoir cascade.
